description: A React component for rendering and managing a 'fill-in-the-blank' challenge in a learning platform, including state management, user input handling, and integration with Redux and GraphQL data.

classes.name: ShowFillInTheBlank
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and handling a fill-in-the-blank challenge, including user input, validation, and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleSubmitNonChinese
methods.description: Handles answer submission for non-Chinese languages, normalizing and comparing user answers to correct answers.

methods.name: handleSubmitChinese
methods.description: Handles answer submission for Chinese language, with specific logic for pinyin and hanzi comparison.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Determines which submit handler to call based on challenge language.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates user answers state when input fields change.
